transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you in today?
I guess… I’m here because when I start eating, sometimes it feels like I’m not really in control anymore. Like I’m telling myself to stop, but I just keep going until I can’t stand it.
Can you tell me more about those times when you feel like you’re not in control while eating? Does it feel like you can’t stop eating once you start?
Yeah… once I start, it’s like I kind of… disappear from it. I’m still thinking, like, stop, you need to stop, but I don’t. I just keep eating until I feel like I can’t take it anymore.
Does this experience of not feeling in control while eating cause you a lot of distress or affect your daily life in any way?

Yeah… it does. I’ve kind of stopped going to a lot of meals or hanging out with people in my dorm, because I’m worried they’ll notice how I am around food.

And school’s been… not great. Some nights just get taken up by thinking about eating, or trying to deal with it after, so studying gets pushed aside.
After you eat, do you ever make yourself sick or use something like laxatives or diuretics to try to get rid of the food or keep from gaining weight?

Yeah… I do. I usually try to get somewhere private, like a dorm bathroom or sometimes a quiet floor in the library, and I make myself throw up. I just get really scared that the food is… staying there, turning into weight.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?
Most weeks… several times. It’s been like that for most of the semester, I guess. I don’t think there’s really been a week in the last few months where it fully stopped.
